segments.en: So it has two airbags for the passenger and for the driver.

segments.zh: 动力转向或也称为辅助转向，它可以让您轻松地转动汽车。

segments.en: But a power steering makes it more automatic.

segments.en: That's right.

segments.en: So it's very easy to turn left or right.

segments.en: That's right.

segments.en: That's right.

segments.zh: 所以这是一个百分比。

segments.en: So if the car is $10,000 and the man says there's a 0% down payment, how much do I have to pay Marco?
segments.zh: 因此，如果这辆车是 10,000 美元，而该男子说有 0% 的首付，我要付多少钱给 Marco？

segments.en: Zero.
segments.zh: 零。

segments.en: Zero.
segments.zh: 零。

segments.en: I don't pay anything today.
segments.zh: 我今天不付任何钱。

segments.en: I pay in a month a little bit and then next month a little bit.
segments.zh: 我在一个月后付了一点钱，然后在下个月付了一点钱。

segments.en: But if the payment is a 10% down payment, then I have to pay $1,000 today.
segments.zh: 但如果付款是 10% 的首付，那么我今天必须支付 1,000 美元。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So as you said, it's usually about things that have a big price tag that are very expensive, a house, a car, these types of things.
segments.zh: 正如你所说，它通常是关于价格昂贵的东西，房子，汽车，这些类型的东西。

segments.en: Usually you need to give a down payment.
segments.zh: 通常你需要支付首付。

segments.en: That means that you're committing to buying it.
segments.zh: 这意味着您承诺购买它。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So a lot of interesting things going on in today's lesson.
segments.zh: 所以在今天的课程中发生了很多有趣的事情。

segments.en: Why don't we listen to the dialogue again and we'll be back to talk some more.
segments.zh: 我们为什么不再听一次对话，我们会回来再谈谈。

segments.en: Hi there.
segments.zh: 你好。

segments.en: I am looking for a new car.
segments.zh: 我正在寻找一辆新车。

segments.en: I have this old Ford Pinto that I would like to trade in.
segments.zh: 我有一辆旧福特平托，想用来以旧换新。

segments.en: I see.
segments.zh: 我明白了。

segments.en: You are in luck this month because all of our 2010 models are on sale.
segments.zh: 这个月你很幸运，因为我们所有的 2010 型号都在打折。

segments.en: It is a perfect time to buy a new car since it's the end of the year.
segments.zh: 这是购买新车的最佳时机，因为它是年底。

segments.en: Perfect.
segments.zh: 太好了。

segments.en: I like this one.
segments.zh: 我喜欢这个。

segments.en: That is the Ford Focus, a very light but powerful vehicle.
segments.zh: 这就是福特福克斯，一辆非常轻巧但功能强大的车辆。

segments.en: It comes with dual side airbags, power steering and power windows, tinted windows and your choice of either automatic or manual transmission.
segments.zh: 它配备两侧安全气囊、助力转向、电动车窗和有色玻璃，自动挡或手动挡由您选择。

segments.en: Sounds like a good car.
segments.zh: 听起来像一辆好车。

segments.en: How many miles to the gallon?
segments.zh: 加仑多少英里？

segments.en: It is a very fuel efficient vehicle, giving you about 34 miles in the city and 40 on the highway.
segments.zh: 这款车很省油，每加仑油在市区能跑约三十四英里，高速公路上能跑四十英里。

segments.en: That is really convenient, especially now that fuel prices are so high.
segments.zh: 这真的很方便，尤其是现在燃料价格如此之高。

segments.en: What's under the hood?
segments.zh: 引擎盖下面装的是什么？

segments.en: A very powerful 2.5 liter turbocharged engine.
segments.zh: 非常强大的2.5升涡轮增压发动机。

segments.en: Trust me, this car is fast.
segments.zh: 相信我，这辆车很快。

segments.en: Now for the most difficult question.
segments.zh: 现在是最困难的问题。

segments.en: What is the price tag for this lovely vehicle?
segments.zh: 这辆可爱的车的价格是多少？

segments.en: Very affordable, ma'am.
segments.zh: 非常实惠，女士。

segments.en: You can take it out of this lot today with zero down payment and no interest for the first year.
segments.zh: 今天您就可以零首付把车开走，而且第一年免息。

segments.en: You can test drive it now and we can sign the papers when we get back.
segments.zh: 您现在可以试驾，我们可以在回来后签署文件。

segments.en: Great.
segments.zh: 太好了。

segments.en: Let's do it.
segments.zh: 我们开始吧。

segments.en: All right, so buying a new car can always be tricky.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以购买新车总是很棘手。

segments.en: What do you prefer though, for example, in these types of features of the car?
segments.zh: 例如，在汽车的这些类型的功能中，您更喜欢什么？

segments.en: For me, a car must be very fuel efficient because number one, cars are all bad for the environment, so I want a car that's less bad for the environment.
segments.zh: 对我来说，汽车必须非常省油，因为第一，汽车对环境都不利，所以我想要一辆对环境不利的汽车。

segments.en: But also, I really like manual transmission because number one, manual transmission is more fuel efficient than automatic.
segments.zh: 而且，我真的很喜欢手动变速箱，因为第一，手动变速箱比自动变速箱更省油。

segments.en: And also, I like to have more control when I'm driving.
segments.zh: 而且，我喜欢在开车时有更多的控制权。

segments.en: I feel safer in a manual transition car because when you do manual, you actually pay more attention to your driving.
segments.zh: 我在手动过渡车上感觉更安全，因为当你做手动时，你实际上会更加注意你的驾驶。

segments.en: You have to concentrate.
segments.zh: 你必须集中注意力。

segments.en: But automatic, you can think about other things and listen to the music.
segments.zh: 但是自动，你可以思考其他事情并听音乐。

segments.en: So I think that that's a safety issue.
segments.zh: 所以我认为这是一个安全问题。

segments.en: But what do you look for?
segments.zh: 但是你在寻找什么？

segments.en: I know you're really, really into cars.
segments.zh: 我知道你真的，真的很喜欢汽车。

segments.en: Yeah, I actually prefer manual transmissions as well, most importantly because of the way that the car drives, especially a sports car.
segments.zh: 是的，我实际上也更喜欢手动变速箱，最重要的是因为汽车的行驶方式，尤其是跑车。

segments.en: It's definitely something for me.
segments.zh: 这绝对是我的东西。

segments.en: It's nice to have a manual transmission.
segments.zh: 有一个手动变速箱很好。

segments.en: But also, little nice features like in the exterior, like the rims, I like nice rims or maybe a nice paint job.
segments.zh: 但是，像外框这样的小功能，比如轮辋，我喜欢漂亮的轮辋，或者可能是漂亮的油漆工作。

segments.en: Tinted windows, I'm not a very big fan of tinted windows.
segments.zh: 有色窗户，我不是有色窗户的忠实粉丝。

segments.en: But yeah, I don't know.
segments.zh: 但是，是的，我不知道。

segments.en: Some cars nowadays, even for, as you said, politicians, they even sell them bulletproof.
segments.zh: 现在有些汽车，即使正如你所说，政客，他们甚至卖给它们防弹。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: They have bulletproof glass.
segments.zh: 他们有防弹玻璃。

segments.en: Very, very secure.
segments.zh: 非常非常安全。

segments.en: Well, for me, I don't think I need bulletproof glass, but a good stereo is a good start.
segments.zh: 好吧，对我来说，我认为我不需要防弹玻璃，但一个好的立体声是一个好的开始。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: You want to have good speakers and...
segments.zh: 你想有好的扬声器和...

segments.en: You can connect your iPod to the stereo now.
segments.zh: 您现在可以将 iPod 连接到立体声。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So a lot of great things with cars.
segments.zh: 所以有很多很棒的汽车。

segments.en: And actually, the model that they mentioned, the Ford Pinto, is a very popular but very bad car.
segments.zh: 实际上，他们提到的车型福特平托是一款非常受欢迎但非常糟糕的汽车。

segments.en: It used to be...
segments.zh: 它曾经是...

segments.en: It was cheap.
segments.zh: 它很便宜。

segments.en: It was cheap, but it wasn't very good.
segments.zh: 它很便宜，但不是很好。

segments.en: In the 1970s and 80s, this was a very common car.
segments.zh: 在 1970 年代和 80 年代，这是一辆非常常见的汽车。

segments.en: And it's famous for being a small, cheap car.
segments.zh: 它以小型廉价汽车而闻名。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: It was a very cheap car.
segments.zh: 这是一辆非常便宜的车。

segments.en: Yes, exactly.
segments.zh: 对，没错。

segments.en: So maybe you can come to our website, EnglishPod.com, and you can tell us if you have a car, what was your first car?
segments.zh: 所以也许你可以来我们的网站 Englishpod.com，你可以告诉我们如果你有车，你的第一辆车是什么？

segments.en: And did you buy a new car or a used car?
segments.zh: 你买的是新车还是二手车？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Secondhand cars.
segments.zh: 二手车。

segments.en: So let us know.
segments.zh: 所以，请告诉我们吧。

segments.en: And of course, if you have any questions, we're always there on the website, EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 当然，如果您有任何问题，我们总是在网站 englishpod.com 上。

segments.en: And we'll see you guys there.
segments.zh: 我们会在那里见到你们。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。

segments.en: Good drive.
segments.zh: 好驱动。
